info.title: Lekto DMS API
info.description:
Lekto is a headless document management system; this API is the only way in.

Errors are problem details (RFC 9457, `application/problem+json`).

Authentication: a session cookie from `POST /auth/login` (web UI; changing requests also send
the header `X-CSRF-Token`) or a personal API token as `Authorization: Bearer lekto_…`. Every
endpoint needs one of them (401 without), except health and the sign-in endpoints: `POST
/auth/login` and, below `/auth/oidc`, information, start and callback. A `read` token may only
read (403). The own sign-in (password, sessions, TOTP, API tokens, provider links) and
creating users or resetting their sign-in need a session; a token gets 403 there. Documents
and spaces the caller may not see are "not found" (404), the same as ones that do not exist.

The same services are available to AI clients over MCP (Streamable HTTP, stateless) at
`/api/v1/mcp`, with the same API tokens as bearer; it is not part of this OpenAPI document.
Tools: `search`, `get_document`, `get_text`, `update_metadata` (needs a `read_write` token),
`list_tags`.

post.summary: Sign in with username and password
post.description: Starts a session: the cookie is HTTP-only, `SameSite=Lax` and, in production, `Secure`. With TOTP on, a correct password without `code` (or `recovery_code`) answers 401 with `second_factor_required: true`. A session this browser had ends. Failed attempts are counted per account and per address; too many answer 429 with `Retry-After`.

`field` `op` `value`. Operators by field: contact, document_type: `is`, `in`, `present`,

model set it and nobody confirmed it); tags (document tags), contact_group (the groups of

number, amount, date fields: `is`, `gt`, `lt`, `present`, `missing`; text and link

`present`, `missing`; boolean: `is`, `present`, `missing`; period fields: `is`,

topic_id.description: One of the contact's topics it points to (a personnel number to work): found in a document, it is evidence for the contact and the topic. Not for a rejected one.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The user a customer or personnel number belongs to (Anna's contract): found in a document, it is hard evidence for whose it is. Not for other kinds, not for a rejected one.

IdentifierIn.title: IdentifierIn
IdentifierIn.description:
Written as in documents; lekto stores it normalised (an IBAN without spaces, a domain
without `www.`).

source.description: `manual`: entered by hand (by an admin, or by the user it names); `learned`: found by training in confirmed documents of only this contact; `rejected`: learned, then rejected by an admin or declined by the user it named (does not count, and training does not learn it again).

InboxDoneOut.title: InboxDoneOut
InboxDoneOut.description: How a document left the caller's inbox.

done.description: How it left the inbox; `done` only.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

worst_lane.description: The worst lane among the open documents, `red` before `yellow` before `green` (new ones); null with only documents in processing, or none.

InboxSummaryOut.title: InboxSummaryOut
InboxSummaryOut.description: How many documents stand under each tab of the caller's inbox.

outdated.title: Outdated

embedded.title: Embedded

vectors.title: Vectors
vectors.description: Vectors in all, one per section of a text.

indexing.title: Indexing
indexing.description: Whether the index is writing right now.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Its size on disk, if the index tells.

kinds.title: Kinds

run_at.description: When it is or was due.

started_at.title: Started At

finished_at.title: Finished At
finished_at.description: When it was done or given up.

document.description: The document it works on, if the caller may read it.

document_hidden.title: Document Hidden
document_hidden.description: It works on a document the caller may not read (or one deleted since).

node.description: The processing step it runs, for `pipeline.node`.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: The name of the contact it works on.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why its last attempt failed, as the worker wrote it (English, for admins; null for other users).

retry.description: For an admin and a failed job: `job` to queue it again (`POST /jobs/{id}/retry`), `document` to repeat the failed step at its document (`POST /documents/{id}/retry`); null otherwise.

total.title: Total
total.description: How many jobs match in all.

next_offset.title: Next Offset
next_offset.description: Pass as `offset` for the next page; null on the last page.

Where a job stands for the people looking at it: a queued job is due once its time has
come, planned before (a repetition, a recurring job).

count.title: Count

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: By kind; kinds without jobs left out.

last_started_at.title: Last Started At

now.title: Now

kept_since.title: Kept Since

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: Given up, within the retention period.

text.title: Text

LabelCheckOut.title: LabelCheckOut
LabelCheckOut.description: The label the model gave for a field's value, and whether the value stands by it.

space_id.description: The space it lies in: its members have the rights.

topic_id.description: A topic (tag of scope `topic`) the contact enables; at most one.

page_count.description: Pages of the document, once its page images are rendered (`pages` node).

confirmed_at.description: When a person last set or confirmed the metadata (in the inbox, or by changing contact, type, topic, tags, date or fields; adding or removing tags set by hand alone does not count), or it was taken over with the source system's; null while it is the pipeline's own. space_confirmed_at.title: Space Confirmed At
space_confirmed_at.description: When a person last decided the space: confirming in the inbox (also keeping it), moving or handing the document over, choosing it on upload, or a migration; null while the pipeline or rules placed it. Such documents teach the classifier the space.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the document came in: when Lekto received it, unless a migration took over the source system's date or it was set since (`PATCH`). `sort=created_at` orders by it.

in_inbox.title: In Inbox
in_inbox.description: It stands open in the caller's inbox (`GET /inbox`; with `all_users`, in every user's): in processing, yellow, red, or new and not seen by the caller.

LocationOut.description: Where a quote stands in the archive PDF.

token_scope.description: With an API token: its scope.

display_name.description: How others see the member; null: the username.

user.title: User
user.description: The user message, with the document's text.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: The model's text as it came.

usage.description: The endpoint's usage report as it sent it: `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, with some endpoints (Ollama through OpenWebUI) durations and speeds; empty if none.

ModelCallOut.description: One request to the language model and its answer.

in_code.description: The payee of a GiroCode on the pages.

spans.title: Spans
spans.description: Where it stands in the text.

reasons.description: The reasons with their codes (`reason` in English).

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: Whether a part of the text was left out.

NodeReviewOut.description: The latest run of classification or field extraction by the model.

NoteKind.description: Why a rule's action was not applied, or a review the rule forces.

OpenNodeOut.description: A node that was uncertain or failed, with the fields left to decide.

words.title: Words
words.description: The words recognised on the page.

unsure.title: Unsure
unsure.description: Of them, those the reader was unsure of: below 60 % of Tesseract's confidence, or what the vision language model could not read.

content.title: Content
content.description: Of the words, those that are content: not dot leaders, rules, stray marks of one or two characters, or small print. Null where content was not counted (read before it was, or by the vision language model).

content_unsure.title: Content Unsure
content_unsure.description: Of the content words, those the reader was unsure of; null with `content`.

poor.title: Poor
poor.description: The page counts as poorly read (`LEKTO_POOR_READING_THRESHOLD`): by its content words where counted, else by all.

revoke_tokens.title: Revoke Tokens
revoke_tokens.description: Also revoke all API tokens. Other sessions end anyway.

before it, or all time.

end.title: End

PersonIdentifierIn.title: PersonIdentifierIn
PersonIdentifierIn.description: Written as in documents; Lekto stores it normalised.

nodes.title: Nodes

declined_numbers.title: Declined Numbers
declined_numbers.description: Learned numbers that are not the user's: they are rejected at their contact, and training does not learn them again. Others are left as they are.

vision.description: The archive's text was read by the vision language model.

pages.title: Pages

subject.title: Subject

rule.title: Rule

field.title: Field

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: Documents whose text is read again (not those queued already).

from_node.description: Discard the results from this node on and process again from there.

unchanged.title: Unchanged

skipped.title: Skipped

priority.title: Priority

disabled_reasons.description: The same with its code (one, or none).

managed_by_document_type_id.title: Managed By Document Type Id
managed_by_document_type_id.description: The document type whose title pattern this rule is: it follows the type and is read-only (changing, switching or deleting it is 409); None for other rules.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Actions that were not applied, and why.

version.title: Version
version.description: Counts from 1; every change of the content or of the space adds one.

scope.description: Where the rule belonged with this version.

space_id.title: Space Id
space_id.description: The space the rule belonged to with this version; None: global. A version whose space differs from the one before moved the rule.

calls.title: Calls

RunExchangeOut.description: What a node sent to the language model in one processing run.

score.title: Score

snippet.description: A piece of the text around the first match, as pieces in order; join `text` for the plain text. Never markup.

items.title: Items
items.description: Best first. A page can hold fewer items than `limit`: hits that the caller may no longer read, or that are gone, are left out.

match.title: Match

personal_of.title: Personal Of
